name: chatgpt-chrome-bridge
description: Give Codex context-isolated ChatGPT reasoning with exact-thread follow-ups and Grok natural-writing workers through signed-in Chrome profiles.

interface.shortDescription: ChatGPT reasoning, follow-ups, and Grok writing.
interface.longDescription: Gives Codex two parallel, context-isolated account-backed workers: ChatGPT for deep reasoning, research, analysis, synthesis, critique, generic planning, safe repository snapshots, generated artifacts, and exact-thread follow-up conversations; and Grok for natural prose, rewriting, voice, tone, correspondence, scripts, product copy, and other standalone writing. Codex may choose either worker implicitly when it is a good fit. Both receive only the submitted prompt plus exact user-authorized attachments and cannot see the Codex conversation, project, repository, unlisted files, terminal, local UI, or other agents. A ChatGPT follow-up additionally receives that selected website conversation's own history and returns a fresh job ID with reply lineage. The workers bind to configured Chrome profile directories instead of whichever profile is focused, dynamically discover current account options, launch isolated Chrome off-screen without stealing focus, globally pace actual submissions, support concurrent queues with durable status calls, provide browser inspection as a recovery fail-safe, and close idle worker browsers after preserving verified refreshed login state. Same-ChatGPT-thread replies are serialized locally and through a heartbeat-backed shared lease while unrelated work remains parallel. Terminal local metadata and internal inspection screenshots are automatically age/count bounded without deleting account chats or downloaded deliverables. ChatGPT leaves its current/default model unchanged and exposes only thinking effort, expanding the Advanced menu when needed. Grok additionally exposes shared per-machine availability so every Codex task can skip it after a recorded logout and perform only one verification for stale or unknown state. ChatGPT creates reviewed secret-scanned repository ZIPs and retrieves generated response files. Grok defaults to Fast and files chats in the configured Grok project; ChatGPT defaults to Extra High reasoning and its configured Agents project.
defaultPrompt: Delegate a self-contained general research workstream to ChatGPT
Continue a completed ChatGPT answer with a follow-up
Use Grok to write or rewrite natural-sounding prose
